summary: Two-column immediate binary setting with descriptive copy and an accessible switch.
useWhen: A settings list pairs a setting name and explanation with one immediate on/off control.
avoidWhen: The value needs a text input, multiple choices, or an explicit Save workflow.
accessibility: The visible label names the switch and the optional description supplies its accessible description.
Switch owns focus, keyboard activation, checked state, and disabled semantics. The row adds no second tab stop.
For a settings list, the owner supplies list semantics and marks each row as a list item.
states: The application accepts or rejects change requests by updating the controlled checked value and owns persistence and errors.
Name the enabled setting consistently; the label must not change when the switch is toggled.
responsiveBehavior: The copy wraps while the switch keeps its natural size in the trailing column, including at narrow widths.

styling.rationale: The row owns copy/control spacing; its parent owns the section surface and width.

protected.reason: Preserve the shared settings-row spacing recipe.
